title: App Fails New Customers
body: Many new Mashreq Bank customers likely join this financial institution via a new credit card. This should make Mashreq Bank quite happy given their aggressive credit card sales program. Unfortunately, the app doesn’t mention ‘credit card activation’ on its front page. There are no prompts, no way to access customer service support through the app unless you either have an active Mashreq account with a current Mashreq user ID and password; or you sign up as a new user. Unbeknownst to me, a loan salesman had signed me up to a Mashreq Gold account years ago. I didn’t get the loan but the account apparently remained active. I never had a user ID or password so I couldn’t sign in. I tried to request new ones but this requires a 16 digit credit card. Can’t use that - not activated yet because I cannot sign in to app. The only recourse for my issue is to seek help from customer service. The app doesn’t provide a method to do that unless you sign in. This methodology (or lack thereof) is flawed resulting in unnecessary frustration. The app is supposed to be the centerpiece of Mashreq Bank customer service. It fails.

title: Worst Customer Service Experience
body:
⭐ ZERO STARS IF THAT WERE POSSIBLE!

Mashreq has to be one of the most frustrating banking experiences I have ever had. I made a transfer to my friend, the money was deducted from my account, but my friend never received it. 

And what happens when you need urgent help with YOUR OWN MONEY? You are left fighting with a useless virtual assistant that cannot understand your problem, while getting nowhere trying to reach a REAL HUMAN CUSTOMER SERVICE AGENT!

How can a bank take money from a customer’s account but make it so difficult for that customer to get help when something goes wrong?

This is completely unacceptable. Customers trust banks with their hard-earned money, and we deserve reliable transactions, proper communication, and customer service that actually provides assistance instead of wasting our time and patience.

I should not have to spend days trying to speak to someone about money that has already left my account. Where is the customer service when customers genuinely need it? What is the point of having customer support if customers cannot reach a real person when they have a serious problem?

Mashreq, please stop making customers jump through hoops just to get basic assistance. Fix your customer service, improve your transaction system, and start treating customers like their money and time actually matter!

This experience has seriously damaged my confidence in your bank. Extremely disappointing and absolutely unacceptable. I would not recommend Mashreq based on this experience unless these issues are properly addressed.

DO BETTER, MASHREQ! 😡

title: Account deductions and lack of transparency
body:
I am not satisfied with my experience with my account. I have repeatedly noticed unexplained or “hidden” charges deducted from my account without any prior notification or clear explanation.

In addition, whenever I transfer money from my savings account to my current account, the funds sometimes disappear or are not reflected correctly. Although I receive confirmation messages that the transfer was made, when I check my account afterwards, the balance shows as zero or the money is missing.

Whenever I raise a complaint about these issues, the response is usually that “someone may have accessed the account,” without proper investigation or accountability. This has happened more than once, and each time I have had to follow up multiple times without receiving a proper resolution.

Customer support is also very poor. Calls are often not answered, and email responses take more than three days, which is unacceptable for financial-related issues.

Overall, this is the worst banking experience I have had due to repeated unresolved issues, lack of transparency, and poor customer service.

body: I have been banking with Mashreq for over three years, and the digital experience has consistently been disappointing. While the bank promotes itself as a digital-first institution, the reality is far from it. The app frequently shows inaccurate data, features do not function reliably, and customers are often redirected to digital channels that are themselves broken. There is virtually no real-time support — inquiries take an average of six days to receive a response, and there is no one easily available to speak with. A truly digital bank must deliver both seamless functionality and responsive support Mashreq currently delivers neither.

title: Alternative Login Option Required for Mobile Banking App
body:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am currently unable to log in to the mobile banking application because my phone camera is not functioning, and therefore Face ID/biometric verification cannot be completed.

Although I know my User ID and password, the application does not provide an option to redirect me to a standard User ID and password login page.

I kindly request you to consider providing two login options in the application:

1. Face ID/Biometric login for customers who prefer it.
2. User ID and password login as an alternative, based on the customer’s choice and responsibility.

Making biometric verification mandatory creates a significant disadvantage for customers whose cameras or biometric functions are temporarily unavailable. It can also be particularly difficult for customers working offshore Remote or in locations where immediate device repair or replacement is not possible.

Please treat this as an urgent login/access concern and assist me in enabling User ID and password login at the earliest.

Thank you for your prompt support.

Best regards,
Varghese

title: Extremely disappointed with mashreq neo
body:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Mashreq Neo.

I opened a new account last digit 9841 and transferred AED 150 just to test how the service works. Instead of being able to use my own money, the entire amount was taken as a “maintenance fee” that was never clearly communicated during the account setup.

After contacting customer support, they confirmed that the deduction was indeed a fee. Charging a brand new customer like this, without clearly explaining it beforehand, is extremely misleading and damaging to customer trust.

A bank should operate with transparency and integrity. Taking the full balance of a new account as a fee creates the impression of hidden charges and unfair practices.

If this issue is not resolved and the AED 150 is not refunded, I will escalate this complaint further and continue sharing this experience publicly so others are aware before opening an account.

This situation should be addressed immediately.

title: Extremely Unsafe App – Total Security Failure
body:
This is one of the worst banking app experiences I have ever had. My transaction approval system was completely compromised. When I received a notification to approve a transaction and tried to decline it, the app kept showing “Something went wrong.”

Because of this serious app failure, an unauthorized $1 transaction went through, followed immediately by another fraudulent $100 transaction. At the same time, the app refused to open, repeatedly showing the same error and preventing me from blocking my card.

I was forced to call customer service to block my card while money was already being stolen. This is a critical security flaw, not a minor bug. A financial app that fails at the exact moment it is needed is completely unreliable and dangerous.

I am extremely disappointed and do not trust this app at all. Strongly warning others—this app is not safe for transactions.

title: Mobile banking at it's best!
body: Snapp has reached where no mobile baking app has ever reached in the Middle East. The securities integration is real big one and it keeps surprising me with it's every single update! Real banking on the go! Rich interface, simple and easy to use and not to mention almost all my day-to-day banking requirements are covered it's like my bank with me on the go! author: Mobile-Guru

title: Fund transfer error and amount deducted twice
body:
There is an issue in fund transfer for this app. It won't allow you to track the transfer done. Moreover there is no transaction log of transfer. 

This is what happened to me... I did a money transfer via snap app. Even after 4 to 5 days the transfer didn't happen and there was no transaction log. Called customer care and they said the request is in progress. After one week called again and escalated. They told the transfer is rejected and to re-initiate the transfer. Second time I did transfer via normal Mashreq website and it happened successfully. After 10 days I found that the transfer done via snap got processed again and money got deducted from my account twice. Called customer care and they said they can't do anything about that and they will take a feedback about this !!!! 
Customer got money deducted twice and bank telling they will just take a feedback ???? That's not acceptable at all. 
Never rely on fund transfer via snap app. Always do via Mashreq online.
author: Frequent Snapp user

title: "Just app n snapp"

title: Dubai
body:
⭐ 1-Star Review – Unexplained Negative Balance and No Customer Support

I am extremely disappointed with Mashreq Neo.

My account balance repeatedly changes from positive to negative every 2–3 days without any clear explanation. On some occasions, my balance was positive by AED 15, but later it became negative. I have documented several negative balances, including -AED 6.70, -AED 12.29, -AED 14.68, -AED 24.24, and -AED 28.14.

These frequent changes do not appear to follow the monthly fee deduction pattern, and I still have no clear explanation for what is happening.

I emailed Mashreq on 3 October 2026 requesting an investigation, but I have received no response. I also tried contacting customer support by phone and through the virtual assistant, but I could not get proper assistance or reach someone who could resolve the issue.

Mashreq, please respond publicly and explain why my balance keeps turning negative every 2–3 days. I expect a detailed breakdown of the transactions or charges involved, a proper investigation, and a clear solution.

Customers should not have to repeatedly chase their bank just to understand what is happening to their own money.
author: Lokaam223

reply.body:
Hello Lokaam,
We understand your concern regarding the changes in your account balance and the importance of having clarity. Please note that maintaining the required minimum balance is essential to avoid applicable fall-below fees. For further clarification, kindly write to us at smfeedback@mashreq.com, mentioning the reference number #664731, and our team will be happy to assist.

title: Horrible banking experience

The chat support link they give you sends you to this app, so if you have trouble getting in you will never get a solution - peak stupidity on user experience. 3. The app now says it requires biometrics, but tapping on “go to settings” brings you to the Mashreq settings (on iPhone) where there is absolutely nothing you can set/toggle to enable the biometrics they require. My Face ID is working fine, I’m on the latest iPhone and iOS and yet there is no way to access this app - absolutely ridiculous, let alone the fact that this forced biometrics login is just a random requirement from Mashreq, all competitors like ENBD and Wio (which are both much better in app design and support availability) either let you enter the app with username and password if you’re not using biometrics like Face ID or actually work well with them unlike Mashreq. Stay away from this bank, if they treat customers like that they do not deserve to have any.

title: Disappointing Experience with New Face Verification Feature
body:
I’ve been a loyal user of Mashreq Bank’s mobile app, but my recent experience with the newly introduced 6-digit PIN registration and face verification feature has been extremely frustrating.

After logging in, I was forced to set up the new 6-digit PIN, supposedly for added security and fraud prevention. However, to complete this, I had to go through the face verification process. I followed all instructions carefully — removed my glasses, ensured there was no background obstruction, and used proper lighting — but still couldn’t verify my identity.

The most frustrating part? I urgently needed to register a beneficiary to transfer money, and the app wouldn’t allow me to proceed without completing the face verification. It turned a simple, urgent task into a nightmare.

It’s clear this feature wasn’t properly tested before release. Please take user experience seriously — especially for something as critical as banking. I strongly urge Mashreq to review their QA process, bring in skilled testers, and avoid outsourcing without thorough quality checks. Security is important, but not at the cost of usability.

I hope this is addressed immediately. No customer should have to go through this level of frustration.
author: RakeshSys

reply.body:
Hello Rakesh,
We understand that this may have caused inconvenience. We value your feedback and has been escalated to the relevant team for review. We are committed to enhancing our services to better serve our customers and look forward to providing you with a more seamless experience in the future.

title: About 15 years behind the times
body: Coming from another country (expat living in the UAE) I find Mashreq’s app difficult, cumbersome and best described as very basic, bordering on the primitive. Examples: No search whatsoever - if you want to find a transaction, you’re only option is to browse through your transactions, one by one. No transaction details either - you get a long, impossible to read transaction string that hides the merchant name somewhere in the middle in between a bunch of internal codes and that’s it. Card functionality is 2005 level - you can set the daily limit and that’s it - no virtual cards or any functionality beyond the most badic, nothing one would expect in 2026. UI and UX are primitive. I guess Mashreq never bothered to check out Revolut or any other decent online bank offering because if they did, they would see that Mashreq is light years behind them.

title: Very disappointed with Mashreq customer support.
body:

I have tried to resolve this issue around 10 times through email and also submitted requests through Mashreq’s customer support website. Unfortunately, nothing has been done to actually solve the problem. The only responses I keep receiving are acknowledgements saying that my message has been received, without any proper resolution or follow-up.

The account is closed, so I understand that it cannot be used as a normal bank account. My issue is that Mashreq still has the closed account appearing in Aani, and this needs to be removed/de-linked.

I’m sharing this publicly because I believe customers should be able to get a simple issue like this resolved without having to repeatedly contact customer support and receive the same generic response.
